summary: Audited 14 pages (historian UI, immersive, ar, watch-together, turning-points, find-ancestor, cinematic-export, living-ledger, privacy, terms, 404, embed, diagnostics, unit-rendering-reference) plus shared plumbing they inherit. 92 fix specs (1 critical, 35 high, 47 medium, 9 low); full long-form with code sketches, copy deck, test matrix, sequencing (Tier 0-3, ~95-100 person-days serial; Tier 0+1 in ~2-3 weeks removes visible brokenness) and open questions is in the report file. Newly proven defects beyond the earlier audit: (1) the map app parses only ?ancestor= (bundle.pretty.js:101019) so every ?tick=/?vignette=/?unit= 'See this moment on the map' link on 8+ pages is dead and the app's own ?t=&u=&z=&ll= share links are never read; (2) screenshots/day1.png and day3.png are byte-identical, malformed (RGB header, RGBA data) near-black placeholders used as every og:image and manifest screenshot; (3) all 137 Historian chronology answers render the word 'undefined' (data key is 'event', code reads description/title) and raw IDs like 'U-I / U-I-1-1' leak into prose; (4) Living Ledger starts at 4 because of an inclusive-loop off-by-one and overshoots the dataset by 838 (47,001 vs 46,163) while ignoring the file's documented bell-curve model; (5) Immersive: Pause leaves the drone running, cannon is eligible in 662/675 ticks including all 135 'night' ticks, no limiter/mute/silent path; (6) AR requests iOS motion permission after two awaits (gesture likely lost), treats Chrome's relative alpha as compass, ignores ~10-11 degree declination, leaks camera stream and GPS watch on failure/exit, and shows 22 of 30 labels stacked from Little Round Top; (7) Watch Together imports/notes go through innerHTML (stored XSS via shared tour files), empty 'Add stop' adds tick 1, and PeerJS 1.5.4 defaults to 0.peerjs.com + Google STUN + PeerJS shared TURN (verified in the library) with no SLA; recommended replacement is a Netlify Function+Blobs polling relay (no WebSockets on Netlify Functions) with server-issued host-token rooms; (8) Cinematic Export throws unhandled on Safari<18.4, captions/attribution are DOM and never in the video, and copy claims 'narrated flyover' with no audio; deterministic WebCodecs+MP4 renderer specified; (9) NPS CWSS is an unmaintained index with no documented API/bulk data: deep-link out, do not scrape; (10) embed.html live headers still carry X-Frame-Options DENY + frame-ancestors * + report-only CSP (netlify.toml empty-string override did not work): Edge Function fix; docs/oEmbed missing; diagnostics.html hidden only by a force redirect; unit-rendering-reference.html is a live dev prototype with a perpetual rAF loop. Mapbox bundled version equals the CDN pin (3.24.1) so no skew today, only drift risk. Not verified: anything requiring a real browser/device (iOS AR gesture chain, Safari recording, VoiceOver, caption/logo overlap), declination value, WebCodecs version support, Netlify header-override and Blobs option semantics; legal points need counsel.
